body: Deliver the minimum complete daily change-evidence loop. Reuse existing primitives and remove glue before adding another framework.

completion.reason: AC1: docs/DOGFOOD.md daily adopter path (steps 1-11) joins task context, impact, CEM, OCM, frontier, checks, independent verification and retained outcome (decision 0314, DCW-V0 requirements). AC2: the fail-closed table and the observed refusals (sealed-head, dogfood-report-missing, patch-digest-mismatch, cite-span-not-stable) refuse stale, dirty, interrupted, unsupported and unknown evidence, and DCW-V0-015 keeps structural closure distinct from correctness. AC3: a fresh agent completed the real V1-0148 change through the daily path with the extracted v0.7.0 build 46 binary accepted as CORVINT_BIN at dogfood-change, dogfood-check (outputsAgree true, author side) and dogfood-seal (PR #102, sealed CEM = first evidence digest), and an independent reviewer completed the reviewer leg from the same extracted archive in a fresh clone (BUILD-LOG 2026-09-23 V1-0146 entry, reviewer report = second evidence digest). NOT_OBSERVED: reviewer-side verifier agreement (dogfood-check needs the author's local report; ticket filed). NOT_RUN: `ocm link`/`ocm mark` (V1-0142 open); `make gate` on the PR branches (owner policy; CI is the repository-wide gate). Thirteen product-friction tickets filed from the two legs.

title: Deliver one complete daily change-evidence loop
